tail_sampling.timed: every write and one get in 7
tail_sampling.window: at least seconds, then until 1,000 get and set samples, at most 10 s

scaling.about: does sharding scale, and what does it cost

pagecache.about: profiling variants: does a smaller page cache cost speed, threads and processes

sizing.about: page-cache sizing cases: stability of small page caches, up to 64 KiB inline values

meta.memory: MiB over the post-import baseline of each case process, measured just after the window: rss_growth = current RSS (includes resident pages of mapped files, such as stock diskcache's 64 MiB database mmap), peak_growth = ru_maxrss, private_growth = process-private memory (macOS phys_footprint, Linux Private_Dirty + Swap; excludes mapped files); procs cases report the median process
